title: FinTech Corp Customer Data Leak Incident
description: Fictional test case: Investigation into unauthorized disclosure of customer transaction summaries on a public forum.

evidence.title: API Gateway Bulk Export Telemetry
evidence.content: API Gateway recorded an unexpected 45,000-record CSV export query using service account token 'svc_payment_read' from internal IP 10.0.4.12 at 03:00:10 UTC.

evidence.title: DevOps Engineer Shift Handover Note
evidence.content: DevOps Engineer Maya Lin notes that service token 'svc_payment_read' was invalidated and regenerated as part of scheduled routine rotation at 02:30:00 UTC.

evidence.title: Public Pastebin Leak Sighting
evidence.content: An unverified public paste containing 20 masked customer records matching the schema was posted at 02:45:00 UTC, 15 minutes before the recorded gateway export at 03:00:10 UTC.
